content.short: Omnichain modular liquid staking protocol for yield maximization and LST-backed lending across multiple blockchains.
content.description:
Accumulated Finance is an omnichain modular liquid staking protocol designed to maximize the yield, liquidity, and utility of staked assets. Users can stake PoS assets to mint Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs) at a 1:1 ratio, which can then be used as collateral in an isolated lending market to borrow base assets.

The platform features "Leverage Staking," enabling users to achieve up to 50x leverage through recursive staking. Operating on the AEVM app-chain, it provides a specialized environment optimized for cross-chain LST interactions and low-cost DeFi operations for all users.
